292113836_5568859f.text: PVN corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH) neurons are key regulators of stress-related endocrine and behavioral responses

292113836_9f9dc8d1.text: the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (PVN) is of particular interest because it participates not only in energy balance but also in neuroendocrine stress responses and anxiety-related behaviors (Füzesi et al., 2016)(Qiu et al., 2024)(Milanick et al., 2019)

292113836_516de3e8.text: we hypothesized that an Arc AgRP -PVN CRH pathway may provide a circuit-level mechanism through which chronic HFD- associated metabolic perturbation is linked to anxiety-like behavior

292113836_41677b84.text: The lateral hypothalamic area (LHA) is another major hypothalamic hub for feeding regulation and reward-related motivated behavior and receives dense inputs from multiple upstream nuclei, including the PVN (Stuber et al., 2016)

292113836_e488522e.text: under chronic HFD-associated anxiety-susceptible conditions, inhibitory input from PVN CRH neurons could reduce the activity of LHA Glu neurons and thereby weaken their anorexigenic output, resulting in disinhibition of food intake.
